descGu: Rule શોધો! AI exactly આ જ કરે.
descEn: Find the rule — just like AI does!
descDa: Find reglen — præcis som AI gør!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Pattern recognition = ML નો heart. AI examples study → rule find → predict. Variables (x) = unknowns = coding backbone.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Pattern recognition is the heart of Machine Learning (ML). Find rules to predict next items. Variables (x) represent unknowns.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Mønstergenkendelse er hjertet i maskinlæring (ML). Studer eksempler → find reglen → forudsige. Variabler (x) er det ukendte tal i programmering.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Chess rice story: 1,2,4,8,16... Rule = double! Box 64 = trillion grains! Simple rule = huge power!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Doubling pattern: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16... Doubling 64 times gets to trillions! Simple patterns have incredible power.
teacherGuide.storyDa: Fordoblingstricket: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16... Hvis vi fordobler 64 gange, får vi trillioner! Simple mønstre har enorm styrke.
teacherGuide.scriptGu: '2,4,6,8 — rule? +2! Computer pattern ઓળખે. YouTube suggestions = pattern!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Skip counting: 3, 6, 9... What's the rule? Add 3! AI finds patterns in what you watch to recommend new videos.
teacherGuide.scriptDa: At tælle i 3-spring: 3, 6, 9... Hvad er reglen? Læg 3 til! AI finder mønstre i det, du ser, for at anbefale nye videoer.
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Spot patterns in daily routines or tile shapes. Show how loops in code repeat these patterns.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Find mønstre i hverdagen (f.eks. striber på tøj, ugedage). Forklar, at loops i kode gentager disse mønstre.

questions.textDa: Find reglen — hvad er det næste tal?

questions.hintEn: AI finds patterns — just like you did!
questions.hintDa: AI leder efter mønstre — ligesom du lige har gjort!
